Those three programmes were not imported.

The official admission page mentions Diploma in Naturopathy only in a dated application notice and provides no dedicated programme catalogue page; it was not imported because news/application notices are not sufficient catalogue evidence.
The official workshops and certifications page lists ten certificate programme names but gives no programme-specific duration or eligibility, so those fields remain null.

The official Ph.D. page lists Physical Education, Yoga and Inter-Disciplinary as programme areas and explicitly states a three-to-six-year duration; eligibility was left null because no qualifying-entry requirement is stated there.
Eligibility values were included only where the official programme page explicitly states them; session-specific age or registration notes were not imported.
